description: This file defines server-side logic for managing invoice templates within a SvelteKit application. It includes a load function for fetching and transforming a list of invoice templates, as well as actions for creating, updating, and deleting templates via API requests. The file handles filtering, pagination, and error handling, integrating with a Django backend endpoint.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches invoice templates from the API with filtering and pagination, transforms data for frontend use, and handles errors.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new invoice template by sending a POST request with form data to the API.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing invoice template identified by `templateId` using data from form submission.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an invoice template specified by `templateId` via API request.
